data.title: What We Do, Step by Step
data.subtitle: Every image below is a real page from a real audit we ran. Here is the work behind each one, in the order we run it.

items.image_alt: Cover page of a real Content Cucumber audit
items.title: 1. We capture your site as it is
items.text: We start by capturing your site as it renders, then frame the audit around your real buyer and the channel they search in. Every finding from here references that snapshot, so nothing in the report is theoretical.

items.image_alt: Out-of-100 health score with nine-category breakdown
items.title: 2. We score you out of 100, nine categories
items.text: We score the site across nine weighted categories, from crawlability and schema to Core Web Vitals and AI search, with AI split into infrastructure and measured outcome. You see where you stand at a glance and which category is dragging the rest down.

items.title: 3. We show you the full scope up front
items.text: We lay out the entire nine-part deliverable before the findings start. You know what you are getting and why each part is in there. A scoped list of what you receive.

items.image_alt: Tech stack read from a live request
items.title: 4. We read what your site reports
items.text: We pull the ground truth from a live request. Platform, edge, analytics, schema, sitemap, robots, llms.txt, and Open Graph, captured as the site reports it rather than assumed. Every later recommendation builds on this.

items.title: 5. We surface what is holding the score down
items.text: We isolate the two or three issues costing you, each with what is broken, why it matters to your buyer, and what to ship. You get the things that move the needle first, not a 200-item dump you will never work through.

items.title: 6. We grade every check, with severity
items.text: Each category gets a check-by-check table. Pass, Partial, or Fail against a fixed threshold, every item tagged Critical, High, Medium, or Low. Your team can work it line by line without translation.

items.image_alt: Copy-paste schema and Open Graph code blocks
items.title: 7. We hand you the code for the fixes
items.text: Where the fix is code, we write the code. Schema blocks, Open Graph, llms.txt, ready to paste. The roadmap is yours to ship whether or not you ever work with us.

items.image_alt: Live four-engine AI citation test with gauges and share-of-voice donuts
items.title: 8. We test how AI represents you, live
items.text: We run your brand through ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini on real category queries. Per-engine score, share of voice, and the competitors the engines name instead of you. This is the number most audits never give you.

items.title: 9. We sequence it into a 90-day plan
items.text: We turn the findings into a dated plan. What to ship first, what pays off later, and when to re-measure. Front-loaded so the quick wins land in week one.

items.title: 10. We connect findings to outcomes
items.text: We tie every fix to an outcome and a clear engagement structure. A one-time foundation sprint closes the technical gaps, then a content cadence earns AI citation over time. We price to the deliverables you receive.

items.image_alt: The verdict and the production model
items.title: 11. We give you the verdict and the model
items.text: We close with a plain-language verdict and the exact production model that moves the number. This is a fast, beautiful commerce store that still scores 0% in the AI answer layer. The technical half is an afternoon. The authority half is the content, and that is the lesson that maps straight onto your site.
